description: This file provides utility functions for Base64 encoding and decoding, specifically 'base64_encode' and 'base64_decode', utilizing the 'cuttlefish' namespace functions. It includes external references to a base64 utility header and uses standard C++ libraries.

methods.name: base64_decode
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 encoded string into binary data, returning the size of the decoded data or 0 on failure.

methods.name: base64_encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string, returning a pointer to the output buffer or NULL on failure.
